name: Cleanup
description: Clean package caches, old build folders in projects and unused Docker data, with sizes in the dry run

projectRoots.label: Project folders
projectRoots.help: Absolute paths of the folders that hold projects. Build folders are searched below them only. The home directory itself and folders above it are refused. Empty switches the search off.

olderThanDays.label: Minimum age in days
olderThanDays.help: A build folder is removed only when nothing in it was changed for this many days.

patterns.label: Build folders
patterns.help: Folder names (wildcards * and ? allowed). NAME:MARKER matches only when the folder next to it holds an entry matching MARKER, e.g. bin:*.*proj for .NET projects. Folders tracked by Git are never removed.

caches.label: Caches to clean
caches.help: Only caches whose folder exists are measured and removed. The tools fill them again on the next use.

docker.label: Clean Docker
docker.help: Runs docker system prune: stopped containers, unused networks, dangling images and the build cache. Without Docker in PATH nothing happens.

dockerAllImages.label: Remove all unused Docker images
dockerAllImages.help: Removes every image no container uses (docker system prune --all), not only dangling ones.

dockerVolumes.label: Remove unused Docker volumes
dockerVolumes.help: Removes anonymous volumes no container uses (docker system prune --volumes). Their data is lost.

warnAboveMb.label: Warn above this cache size (MB)
warnAboveMb.help: The usage check warns when all caches together are larger. 0 switches the warning off.

caches.label: Clean caches
caches.description: Removes the cache folders of npm, Maven, Gradle, NuGet, pip and uv. The dry run lists each cache with its size.
caches.confirm: The selected caches are deleted. The tools download everything again on the next build, which needs the network and time.

projects.label: Clean build folders
projects.description: Removes old build folders below the project folders. The dry run lists each folder with its size.
projects.confirm: Build folders in the project folders that were not changed for the set number of days are deleted. Folders tracked by Git stay.

docker.label: Clean Docker
docker.description: Runs docker system prune when the setting is switched on. The dry run reports the reclaimable space.
docker.confirm: Stopped containers, unused networks, unused images and the build cache of Docker are deleted, with the matching setting unused volumes as well.
